description: NMR peak list (ppm, height, width, S/N) and integrals of given regions or of every multiplet (auto_integrate), from the vendor's processed spectrum or a spectrum processed from the FID (from=fid: group delay, apodization, zero filling, FT, phase, baseline).

auto_integrate.description: Without integrate: integrate every multiplet (peaks closer than 15 Hz, ±10 Hz).

baseline.description: Baseline: `default` (order-1 polynomial), `none`, `poly:N`. Stored spectra are used as stored unless this is given.

file.description: Path to the file or data-set directory.

from.description: `auto` (default: the vendor's processed spectrum if present, else process the FID), `fid` (always process the FID), `processed` (stored spectrum only).

integral_reference.description: Normalise integrals so region `[index, value]` has that value (default `[0, 1]`).

integrate.description: Regions to integrate, `[[a, b], …]` in ppm.

lb.description: Exponential line broadening in Hz (0 = none; default stored, else 0.3 Hz 1H / 1 Hz other).

max_peaks.description: Keep at most this many peaks (tallest; default 200).

min_height_fraction.description: Minimum height as a fraction of the tallest point (default 0; e.g. 0.01).

min_snr.description: Minimum peak height in noise SDs (default 10).

phase.description: `default` (stored phases, else automatic), `stored`, `auto`, `magnitude`, `none`, or `"P0,P1"` in degrees.

range_ppm.description: Only pick between two shifts, `[a, b]` ppm.

size.description: Transform size in complex points (power of two).

strict.description: Refuse values the file's assurance does not validate (exit_code 6). Default: the server's.

name: openreadout_nmr_peaks

Apodization.description: Window function applied to the FID.

line_broadening_hz.description: Added Lorentzian full width at half height, Hz.

oneOf.description:
`e^{−(π·GB·t)²/(4 ln 2)}`: multiplies each line by a Gaussian of `line_broadening_hz`
full width at half height.

line_broadening_hz.description: Gaussian full width at half height, Hz.

oneOf.description: Polynomial through automatically recognised baseline blocks (module docs).

order.description: Polynomial order (0 = constant offset); at most 8.

oneOf.description: The default: polynomial of order 1 (offset and tilt).

FidParameters.description: What the processing needs to know about an acquisition.

carrier_frequency_mhz.description: Carrier (transmitter) frequency, MHz: the centre of the spectrum.

conjugate.description: Complex-conjugate the FID before the transform (reverses the frequency axis).

group_delay_points.description: Digital-filter group delay in points (0 when the data carry none).

reference_frequency_mhz.description: Frequency of 0 ppm, MHz (the referencing frequency).

spectral_width_hz.description: Spectral width (Hz): the complex sampling rate.

from_ppm.description: High-shift end of the region, ppm.

normalized.description:
`value` rescaled so the reference region has the reference value (`None` when the
reference integral is 0 or missing).

to_ppm.description: Low-shift end of the region, ppm.

value.description: Sum of the points × point spacing (intensity·ppm).

snr.description: |height| / noise SD (`None` when the noise SD is 0).

width_hz.description: Full width at half height, Hz (`None` when overlapping lines hide the half-height point).

width_ppm.description: Full width at half height, ppm.

max_peaks.description: Keep at most this many peaks (the tallest).

min_height_fraction.description: Minimum height as a fraction of the tallest point in the searched range (0 = off).

min_prominence_snr.description: Minimum prominence as a multiple of the noise SD.

min_snr.description: Minimum height as a multiple of the noise SD.

range_ppm.description: Only search between these shifts (ppm, either order).

PpmAxis.description: A regular chemical-shift axis: point `k` is at `first_ppm + k · step_ppm`.

first_ppm.description: Chemical shift of point 0 (the left, high-frequency edge), ppm.

reference_frequency_mhz.description: Frequency of 0 ppm, MHz (converts ppm to Hz).

step_ppm.description: Increment per point, ppm (negative: shifts decrease left to right).

ProcessingRecord.description: What was done, with the values actually used.

apodization_source.description: Where the window width came from: `stored`, `default`, `option`.

stored.description: Stored processing values found (may be unused).

StoredProcessing.description: Processing parameters the vendor software stored with the data, in this crate's conventions.

first_point_factor.description: Factor applied to the first FID point (Bruker `FCOR`); `None`: 0.5.

phase0_deg.description: Zero-order phase, degrees (`φ0` of the module docs).

phase1_deg.description: First-order phase across the whole spectrum, degrees (`φ1`).

source.description: Where they came from, e.g. `pdata/1/procs` or `procpar`.

spectrum_stored.description: True when the vendor software also stored a processed spectrum made with these values.

time_domain_points.description: Complex FID points the vendor processing used (Bruker `TDeff` / 2); `None`: all.

axis.description: The chemical-shift axis of the spectrum.

main_peak.description: The tallest positive peak (named like `analyze peaks` → `main_peak` for chromatograms).

noise_sd.description: Robust noise standard deviation (same units as `height`).

processing.description: How the FID was processed (`source` = `fid` only).

source.description: `processed` (a spectrum the vendor software stored) or `fid` (processed here).
